meaning:
κουφίζω
(κοῦφος, light), [in LXX: Exo.18:22, Jon.1.5, al. (קָלַל hi.), Est.5:1, al. ;]
1. intrans., to be light (poetic chiefly).
2. to lighten, make light: with accusative, Act.27:38.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: When they had eaten enough, they lightened the ship, throwing out the wheat into the sea.
